purpose: learn from an incident in writing, blamelessly, and make sure the lessons become tracked work
procedure: Summarize impact, duration, detection time and recovery time with numbers.
Write the timeline and what went well, what went badly and where luck helped.
Link the RCA findings; agree actions with owners and dates.
Review in a blameless meeting; capture disagreements.
Track actions to completion and report overdue ones.
acceptance_criteria: Every action is in the tracker with owner and date
Postmortem is published within the agreed time

validation.check: compare action list in the document with tracker items
validation.expect: every action has an issue id

validation.check: check postmortem publish date against incident close date
validation.expect: within the agreed number of days

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A forty-minute checkout outage produces a two-page postmortem with six actions, each in the tracker; the follow-up report shows five complete after a month.
